title: Digimon World 2003 (Europe)
notes: Stage rules come from the roles the decompilation documents for each overlay:
STDWTITL is the title screen and the opening movies; FIELDSTG is the field mode
the player walks around in; CNTY_SEL is the country select; STAGSLCT is the debug
stage select; the WSTAG### overlays are the individual stages that load on top of
FIELDSTG. AAA/DAT, AAA/PRO and AAA/STR are only reachable through the ISO 9660
path table, which the analyser merges in.
The first-playable set is a starting hypothesis, not a measurement: it keeps the
title, the field engine, country select and the first ten stages together so that
the first area and the menus around it arrive before 250 movies and stage programs.
Run `psxpress analyze <disc> --profile profiles/dw3-eu.json` and check the
`unmatched`/warnings output against your disc before trusting the split.
